title: 第十七章 不说这个怕你骄傲第十八章 被耍了
slug: 兽校开局被强吻我被疯批们娇宠
content_zh:
裴殷戾气还没熄灭，一阵狂风在他身后刮起。
“又在搞什么鬼？”
刚换好的衣服，下摆剧烈摇晃，他身上挂满链子，哐当哐当地响。
回过头，顺着盛越的视线看去。
“哟，6号别墅怎么飞出个鸟人啊。”
裴殷嚣张地挑了挑眉，“我去瞧瞧。”
他背后噌地亮出一对黑翅，直奔凌厌执而去。
闹了一上午脾气的银玖，心急地主动破冰，[快跟上去呀，肯定是出事了。]
它的速度，难不成还比不上听鹰？
盛越正心烦，没搭理银玖。
他原地观察了下裴殷他们的飞行轨迹，思索片刻，朝校医室赶去。
白色的制服，从别墅区掠出，穿过礼堂，留下浅淡的身影。
银玖絮絮叨叨，[都是你下手晚了，不然也不会被凌厌执抢走。]
盛越沉默了一会儿，[她是人，不是玩具。]
他又不喜欢简妤。
……
校医室分等级，靠学生的éV值分配医疗资源。
凌厌执的等级高，去顶楼肯定没错。
裴殷的想法和盛越不谋而合，两人几乎同时追上，前后不过几秒钟。
刚好看见凌厌执跟着简妤进急救室。

“她事怎么这么多？我刚走，她就又进校医室了。”裴殷眼底浮起一层轻蔑的冷光。
可他的脚却仿佛粘在地板上，没有挪动分毫。
想到论坛上的热帖，裴殷继续作死，“上午一趟，下午一趟，晚上又一趟，她干脆住医院算了。”
没得到附和，他也不介意，“他要伺候得不好，还不如送我那，我好歹也算半个医生。”
盛越眼睛下垂，“有本事，等他出来，你再跟他说。”
裴殷：“……”
行，他没本事。
很快，门开了。
“抽血按压方式是正确的，只是她的凝血功能失常，凝血因子合成不足，血小板又少，即使是小伤口，细针口，也会流出大量的血。”
校医的话在耳边清晰回响。
裴殷表情怔住，他嘴巴动了动，准备奚落人的话卡在喉咙里。
是因为抽血？血没有止住吗？
盛越也愣了愣，他迎上去，“没事吧？”
content_en:
Before Pei Yin's anger was extinguished, a strong wind blew behind him.
"What are you doing again?"
The hem of the clothes he had just changed swayed violently, and his body was covered with chains that clanked.
He turned around and followed Sheng Yue's line of sight.
"Hey, why did a birdman fly out of Villa No. 6?"
Pei Yin raised his eyebrows arrogantly, "I'll go take a look."
A pair of black wings flashed out from his back and he headed straight for Ling Yanzhi.
Yinjiu, who had been having a bad temper all morning, eagerly broke the ice and said, "Follow me quickly, something must have happened." ]
Is it possible that its speed is not as fast as that of Ting Ying?
Sheng Yue was upset and ignored Yinjiu.
He observed the flight path of Pei Yin and the others on the spot, thought for a moment, and rushed towards the school doctor's office.
The white uniform swept out from the villa area and passed through the auditorium, leaving a faint figure behind.
Yinjiu babbled, "It's all because you started too late, otherwise Ling Yanzhi wouldn't have snatched it away." ]
Sheng Yue was silent for a while, "She is a human being, not a toy." ]
He doesn't like Jian Yu.
…
The school doctor's office is divided into levels, and medical resources are allocated based on the students' EV values.
Ling Yanzhi's level was high, so it was definitely a good idea to go to the top floor.
Pei Yin's thoughts coincided with Sheng Yue's, and the two caught up almost at the same time, within a few seconds.
I happened to see Ling Yanzhi follow Jian Yu into the emergency room.
"Why does she have so many things going on? As soon as I left, she entered the school doctor's office again." There was a cold light of contempt in Pei Yin's eyes.
But his feet seemed to be stuck to the floor, not moving at all.
Thinking of the hot posts on the forum, Pei Yin continued to commit suicide, "One trip in the morning, one trip in the afternoon, and another trip in the evening. She might as well go to the hospital."
He didn't mind if he didn't get any support, "If he doesn't serve him well, he might as well give it to me. I'm still half a doctor."
Sheng Yue's eyes drooped, "If you have the ability, wait until he comes out and tell him."
Pei Yin: "..."
Okay, he has no ability.
Soon, the door opened.
"The method of drawing blood and pressing is correct, but her coagulation function is abnormal, the synthesis of coagulation factors is insufficient, and there are few platelets. Even small wounds and fine needle openings will cause a large amount of blood to flow out."
The school doctor's words echoed clearly in my ears.
Pei Yin's expression was stunned, and he moved his mouth, ready to ridicule the words stuck in his throat.
Is it because of the blood draw? Didn't the bleeding stop?
Sheng Yue was also stunned, and he went to greet him, "Are you okay?"
